% Pattern: number/counter-name. A counter whose name ends with a digit, as
% thm0, numbers like any other. Seen in the gold pilot (set X).
% want thm0-1 statement/theorem 1.1 status=none
% want lemma-1 statement/lemma 1.1.1 status=none
% want thm0-2 statement/theorem 2.1 status=none
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{amsthm}
\newtheorem{lemma}{Lemma}[subsection]
\newtheorem{thm0}{Theorem}[section]
\begin{document}
\section{Introduction}
\begin{thm0} Every compact space is bounded. \end{thm0}
\subsection{Subsets}
\begin{lemma} Every closed subset of a compact space is compact. \end{lemma}
\section{Products}
\begin{thm0} Every finite product of compact spaces is compact. \end{thm0}
\end{document}
